$comment: Tier-3 differential spec for the W4.9a image-generation handler
(v4 lib/tools/handlers/image-generation-handler.ts executeImageGenerationTool;
Rust crates/quilltap-core/src/tools/generate_image.rs execute_image_generation_tool)
and the avatar trigger (v4 lib/wardrobe/avatar-generation.ts).
ONE committed file drives BOTH sides. A two-database fixture (main + mount-index)
is baked once by build-image-generation-fixture.ts via v4's REAL repos: a user +
one character (Aurora) with a full provisioned vault + a physicalDescription, image
profiles (a normal default), one default connection profile (the cheap-LLM
candidate), one OFF chat-settings row, a set of chats (one per case), and a
PROVISIONED Lantern Backgrounds `database` mount + its instance_settings id.
MODEL SEAMS (pinned identically both sides):
- the image provider (CannedImageProvider keyed by the oracle-recorded
provider|model|JSON.stringify(params) key; the key proves mergeParameters +
applyOrientation reach the wire — incl. the orientation-driven `size`)
- the completion boundary (CannedCompletionProvider; recorded keys prove the
craft-prompt task message byte-for-byte, and a craft FAILURE drives the
tier-concatenation fallback)
- the WebP transcode (PassthroughTranscoder; the oracle mocks convertToWebP +
transcodeToWebP pass-through so the store bytes match the Rust link_blob_content)
- the API key (canned apiKeyId->key map; the oracle monkey-patches
findApiKeyByIdAndUserId, the Rust ApiKeyResolver injects the same map)
- the orientation registry (canned OrientationSupport: OPENAI a size-strategy
provider so applyOrientation sets a concrete `size`; identical both sides)
- the Lantern notification (no-op; the byte-exact string is unit-tested in Rust)
- Date.now() frozen so the provider filename `generated_<ts>.<ext>` is pinned
PARITY CONSTRAINTS baked into the corpus:
- no project + no aesthetic docs, so v4's resolveAesthetic/resolveDepictionGuidelines
return null/[] (the Rust build_expansion_context injects None — a deferred seam),
keeping the craft-prompt messages byte-identical
- no styleInfo on the constraints, so styleOptions is undefined (Rust never computes it)
SCOPE / tracked deferral: the full Concierge classify + AUTO_ROUTE reroute + the
five-step sanitize gate + the post-hoc moderation reroute are NOT exercised end-to-end
here (they need a per-user danger mode + the process-global classify LRU cache pinned
identically). Those paths are the W4.2 dangerous-content subsystem, which this handler
COMPOSES verbatim and which is proven byte-for-byte by danger_gatekeeper_tier3 /
danger_routing / danger_resolver. This differential proves the handler spine: profile
load + validate, placeholder resolution, the craft expansion + tier-concatenation
fallback, mergeParameters + applyOrientation reaching the image wire, saveGeneratedImage
(the Lantern store write + files row + tag inheritance + revisedPrompt), the unprovisioned
STORAGE_ERROR refusal, and the avatar trigger fire/autonomous-skip/disabled-skip.
SAFETY: testPepperBase64 is a THROWAWAY 32-byte key (the same one folders / tags /
image_profiles fixtures use). NOT the real Friday pepper; safe to commit.
